description: Update a comment→DM automation, or pause/resume it. Passing isActive:false alone pauses it without changing anything else; isActive:true resumes it. Only the fields you pass are changed.

buttons.description: URL buttons; [] removes them. DM max 640 characters with buttons.

commentReply.description: New public reply (empty string removes it)

followersOnly.description: Required for Instagram comment buttons: only known followers receive them.

isActive.description: false pauses the automation, true resumes it
